name: @lenticule-science/mathematical-readout-exchange
description: Union-facing OSS boundary for qualified executable projections grounded in Obsmetrologia mathematics.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: an A2A RMN Mark request naming admissible CoverNerve counts, or the exact normalized RMN cover-nerve law carried by an ActivityStreams solicitation with admissible CoverNerve counts
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: invalid input, source drift, cross-settlement mutation, an unqualified equivalence claim, or unsettled pricing authority

obsmetrologia.coverNerve.rank.accepts: { entities: number, cells: number, components: number } — non-negative safe integers satisfying the CoverNerve bounds
obsmetrologia.coverNerve.rank.returns: { h0rank, h1rank, coordinationFree, landauerBits, coordinationCost, cost, certificate }

obsmetrologia.relationalGraph.readout.accepts: { vertices: string[], edges: [string,string][] } — at least one explicitly sorted unique vertex and canonical sorted unique simple edges
obsmetrologia.relationalGraph.readout.returns: { entities, cells, components, componentPartition, h0rank, h1rank, coordinationFree, landauerBits, coordinationCost, exactRank, harmonicRank, cost, certificate }

scripts.verify: node src/verify-enterprise.mjs && node --check src/law.mjs && node --check bin/serve-a2a.mjs && node --check bin/execute-a2a-task.mjs && node --check src/contract-cover-nerve-readout.mjs && node --check src/relational-graph.mjs && node --check src/relational-graph-protocol.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs && lake env lean scripts/Conformance.lean
